        "contents": "# Local Agent Task: Deploy Email Function\n\n## Summary\nThe email test functionality was taking forever because the Firebase function wasn't actually deployed. I've fixed the code, but the function needs to be deployed from a local environment where Firebase authentication is possible.\n\n## What I've Done\n1. ✅ Fixed &#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96; - The &#96;simpleEmailTest&#96; function now actually sends emails using EmailService\n2. ✅ Fixed &#96;src/pages/SimpleEmailTestPage.tsx&#96; - Now calls the Firebase function instead of simulating with setTimeout\n3. ✅ Added deployment detection - The page now shows if the function is deployed or not\n4. ✅ Fixed build issues - Updated tsconfig.json and temporarily handled problematic imports\n5. ✅ Created deployment guide - See &#96;DEPLOY_EMAIL_FUNCTION_NOW.md&#96;\n\n## What You Need to Do\n\n### Quick Deployment (5 minutes)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Pull the latest changes\ngit pull\n\n# 2. Navigate to project\ncd whosonset\n\n# 3. Build and deploy the function\ncd functions\nnpm install\nnpm run build\ncd ..\nfirebase deploy --only functions:simpleEmailTest\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Email Configuration (if not already set)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Option A: SendGrid (Recommended)\nfirebase functions:config:set sendgrid.api_key=\"YOUR_SENDGRID_API_KEY\"\nfirebase functions:config:set email.from=\"noreply@myfilmjobs.com\"\n\n# Option B: SMTP/Gmail\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.host=\"smtp.gmail.com\"\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.port=\"587\"\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.user=\"your-email@gmail.com\"\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.pass=\"your-app-password\"\nfirebase functions:config:set email.from=\"your-email@gmail.com\"\n\n# Redeploy after setting config\nfirebase deploy --only functions:simpleEmailTest\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Expected Result\nOnce deployed:\n- The email test page will work immediately (no more hanging)\n- Emails will actually be sent (not simulated)\n- The page will show \"✅ Email API: SendGrid integration ready\"\n\n## Success Confirmation\nThe deployment is successful when you see:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

        "contents": "### Supported Notification Types\n- Job Application Notifications\n- Project Invitation Notifications\n- Task Assignment Notifications\n- Message Notifications\n- Project Update Notifications\n- Application Status Notifications\n\n## Firebase Functions\n\n### Function Triggers\n1. **&#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify job poster of new application\n\n2. **&#96;notifyProjectInvitation&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;projectInvitations/{invitationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify invitee of project invitation\n\n3. **&#96;notifyTaskAssignment&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;tasks/{taskId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify assignee of new task\n\n4. **&#96;notifyNewMessage&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify receiver of new message\n\n5. **&#96;notifyProjectUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;Projects/{projectId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify crew members of project changes\n\n6. **&#96;notifyApplicationStatusUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify applicant of status change\n\n## Email Service Configuration\n\n### Environment Variables\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# SendGrid Configuration\nSENDGRID_API_KEY=your_sendgrid_api_key\n\n# SMTP Configuration (fallback)\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=your_email@gmail.com\nSMTP_PASS=your_app_password\n\n# Email Configuration\nFROM_EMAIL=noreply@myfilmjobs.com\nFRONTEND_URL=https://myfilmjobs.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Email Providers\n1. **Primary**: SendGrid (recommended for production)\n2. **Fallback**: Nodemailer with SMTP (Gmail, etc.)\n\n## Implementation Guide\n\n### 1. Setup Email Service\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\ncd functions\nnpm install nodemailer @sendgrid/mail handlebars\n\n# Configure environment variables\n# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Deploy Firebase Functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Deploy functions\nfirebase deploy --only functions\n\n# Set environment variables\n",

            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175,
            "text": "### 1. Setup Email Service"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,

          {

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182,
            "text": "# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment"

        "originalContents": "### Supported Notification Types\n- Job Application Notifications\n- Project Invitation Notifications\n- Task Assignment Notifications\n- Message Notifications\n- Project Update Notifications\n- Application Status Notifications\n\n## Firebase Functions\n\n### Function Triggers\n1. **&#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify job poster of new application\n\n2. **&#96;notifyProjectInvitation&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;projectInvitations/{invitationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify invitee of project invitation\n\n3. **&#96;notifyTaskAssignment&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;tasks/{taskId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify assignee of new task\n\n4. **&#96;notifyNewMessage&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify receiver of new message\n\n5. **&#96;notifyProjectUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;Projects/{projectId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify crew members of project changes\n\n6. **&#96;notifyApplicationStatusUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify applicant of status change\n\n## Email Service Configuration\n\n### Environment Variables\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# SendGrid Configuration\nSENDGRID_API_KEY=your_sendgrid_api_key\n\n# SMTP Configuration (fallback)\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=your_email@gmail.com\nSMTP_PASS=your_app_password\n\n# Email Configuration\nFROM_EMAIL=noreply@myfilmjobs.com\nFRONTEND_URL=https://myfilmjobs.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Email Providers\n1. **Primary**: SendGrid (recommended for production)\n2. **Fallback**: Nodemailer with SMTP (Gmail, etc.)\n\n## Implementation Guide\n\n### 1. Setup Email Service\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\ncd functions\nnpm install nodemailer @sendgrid/mail handlebars\n\n# Configure environment variables\n# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Deploy Firebase Functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Deploy functions\nfirebase deploy --only functions\n\n# Set environment variables\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class EmailService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static async sendEmail(emailData: EmailData): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n    try {\n      this.initialize();\n\n      const { to, template, data } = emailData;\n      \n      // Compile template with data\n      const compiledSubject = handlebars.compile(template.subject);\n      const compiledHtml = handlebars.compile(template.html);\n      const compiledText = handlebars.compile(template.text);\n\n      const subject = compiledSubject(data || {});\n      const html = compiledHtml(data || {});\n      const text = compiledText(data || {});\n\n      // Get from email from environment variables\n      const fromEmailValue = process.env.EMAIL_FROM || 'iam@myfilmjobs.com';\n\n      // Try SendGrid first, fallback to Nodemailer\n      if (this.sendGridApiKey) {\n        console.log('[EmailService] Using SendGrid');\n        await sgMail.send({\n          to,\n          from: fromEmailValue,\n          subject,\n          html,\n          text\n        });\n      } else {\n        console.log('[EmailService] Using Nodemailer');\n        await this.transporter.sendMail({\n          from: fromEmailValue,\n          to,\n          subject,\n          html,\n          text\n        });\n      }\n\n      console.log(&#96;[EmailService] Email sent successfully to ${to}&#96;);\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[EmailService] Error sending email:', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "b) Template Variables:\n   - {{userName}}: Recipient's name\n   - {{senderName}}: Sender's name\n   - {{projectName}}: Project name\n   - {{jobTitle}}: Job title\n   - {{status}}: Application status\n   - {{dueDate}}: Task due date\n   - {{message}}: Message content\n   - {{dashboardUrl}}: Link to relevant page\n\nc) Template Examples:\n\nJob Application Template:\nSubject: \"New Application for {{jobTitle}}\"\nHTML: Professional layout with application details\nText: Plain text version for email clients\n\nProject Invitation Template:\nSubject: \"You're invited to join {{projectName}}\"\nHTML: Project details with accept/decline buttons\nText: Simple invitation text\n\n6. USER INTERFACE COMPONENTS\n================================================================================\n\nNotificationSettings Component:\n- Modern, intuitive interface\n- Real-time feedback with loading states\n- Granular control for each notification type\n- Frequency options (immediate/daily/weekly)\n- Error handling with retry options\n\nNotificationCenter Component:\n- Search and filter functionality\n- Bulk selection and actions\n- Visual type indicators with emoji icons\n- Smart sorting with unread prioritization\n- Real-time updates and status tracking\n\n7.         "contents": "firebase functions:config:set sendgrid.api_key=\"your_api_key\"\nfirebase functions:config:set email.from=\"noreply@myfilmjobs.com\"\nfirebase functions:config:set app.frontend_url=\"https://myfilmjobs.com\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Initialize User Preferences\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Initialize user preferences when user signs up\nawait UserPreferencesService.initializeUserPreferences(userId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Test Notifications\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Test email notification\nawait NotificationService.createNotification({\n  userId: 'test-user-id',\n  type: 'test_notification',\n  message: 'Test notification',\n  sendEmail: true,\n  emailData: {\n    to: 'test@example.com',\n    template: EmailService.getJobApplicationTemplate('Test User', 'Test Job', 'Test Company'),\n    data: { /* template data */ }\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n### Email Notifications\n1. **Respect User Preferences**: Always check user's email notification settings\n2. **Template Consistency**: Use consistent branding and formatting\n3. **Clear Call-to-Action**: Include relevant action buttons\n4. **Fallback Support**: Provide text versions for email clients\n5. **Rate Limiting**: Implement rate limiting to prevent spam\n\n### In-App Notifications\n1. **Real-time Updates**: Use Firebase real-time listeners\n2. **Unread Count**: Track and display unread notification count\n3. **Notification Center**: Provide centralized notification management\n4. **Action Handling**: Enable direct actions from notifications\n\n### User Experience\n1. **Granular Control**: Allow users to customize notification types\n2. **Frequency Options**: Provide different notification frequency options\n3. **Easy Management**: Intuitive settings interface\n4. **Default Settings**: Sensible defaults for new users\n\n## Monitoring and Analytics\n\n### Key Metrics\n- Email delivery rates\n- Notification open rates\n- User engagement with notifications\n- Settings adoption rates\n\n### Error Handling\n- Email delivery failures\n- Template rendering errors\n- User preference loading errors\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "firebase deploy --only functions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190,
            "text": "# Set environment variables"
          },

          {
            "lineNumber": 218,
            "text": "## Best Practices"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220,
            "text": "### Email Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221,
            "text": "1. **Respect User Preferences**: Always check user's email notification settings"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222,
            "text": "2. **Template Consistency**: Use consistent branding and formatting"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223,
            "text": "3. **Clear Call-to-Action**: Include relevant action buttons"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 224,
            "text": "4. **Fallback Support**: Provide text versions for email clients"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 225,
            "text": "5. **Rate Limiting**: Implement rate limiting to prevent spam"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 227,
            "text": "### In-App Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 228,
            "text": "1. **Real-time Updates**: Use Firebase real-time listeners"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229,
            "text": "2. **Unread Count**: Track and display unread notification count"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 230,
            "text": "3. **Notification Center**: Provide centralized notification management"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231,
            "text": "4. **Action Handling**: Enable direct actions from notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233,
            "text": "### User Experience"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 234,
            "text": "1. **Granular Control**: Allow users to customize notification types"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 235,
            "text": "2. **Frequency Options**: Provide different notification frequency options"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 236,
            "text": "3. **Easy Management**: Intuitive settings interface"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237,
            "text": "4. **Default Settings**: Sensible defaults for new users"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 239,
            "text": "## Monitoring and Analytics"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241,
            "text": "### Key Metrics"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 242,
            "text": "- Email delivery rates"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243,
            "text": "- Notification open rates"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 244,
            "text": "- User engagement with notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 245,
            "text": "- Settings adoption rates"
          },

            "lineNumber": 246

Test Notifications\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Test email notification\nawait NotificationService.createNotification({\n  userId: 'test-user-id',\n  type: 'test_notification',\n  message: 'Test notification',\n  sendEmail: true,\n  emailData: {\n    to: 'test@example.com',\n    template: EmailService.getJobApplicationTemplate('Test User', 'Test Job', 'Test Company'),\n    data: { /* template data */ }\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n### Email Notifications\n1. **Respect User Preferences**: Always check user's email notification settings\n2. **Template Consistency**: Use consistent branding and formatting\n3. **Clear Call-to-Action**: Include relevant action buttons\n4. **Fallback Support**: Provide text versions for email clients\n5. **Rate Limiting**: Implement rate limiting to prevent spam\n\n### In-App Notifications\n1. **Real-time Updates**: Use Firebase real-time listeners\n2. **Unread Count**: Track and display unread notification count\n3. **Notification Center**: Provide centralized notification management\n4. **Action Handling**: Enable direct actions from notifications\n\n### User Experience\n1. **Granular Control**: Allow users to customize notification types\n2. **Frequency Options**: Provide different notification frequency options\n3. **Easy Management**: Intuitive settings interface\n4. **Default Settings**: Sensible defaults for new users\n\n## Monitoring and Analytics\n\n### Key Metrics\n- Email delivery rates\n- Notification open rates\n- User engagement with notifications\n- Settings adoption rates\n\n### Error Handling\n- Email delivery failures\n- Template rendering errors\n- User preference loading errors\n",

        "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env node\n\n/**\n * Email Notification Testing Script\n * \n * This script helps test email notifications without deploying Firebase Functions.\n * It tests the local email configuration and provides guidance for testing.\n */\n\nimport nodemailer from 'nodemailer';\n\n// Configuration (same as in Firebase Functions)\nconst config = {\n  smtp: {\n    host: 'smtp.gmail.com',\n    port: 587,\n    secure: false,\n    auth: {\n      user: 'iam@myfilmjobs.com',\n      pass: process.env.SMTP_PASSWORD || 'your-app-password-here'\n    }\n  },\n  email: {\n    from: 'iam@myfilmjobs.com'\n  }\n};\n\nasync function testEmailSending() {\n  console.log('🧪 Testing Email Configuration...\\n');\n\n  try {\n    // Create transporter\n    const transporter = nodemailer.createTransporter(config.smtp);\n    \n    // Verify connection\n    console.log('📡 Verifying SMTP connection...');\n    await transporter.verify();\n    console.log('✅ SMTP connection successful!\\n');\n\n    // Send test email\n    console.log('📧 Sending test email...');\n    const info = await transporter.sendMail({\n      from: config.email.from,\n      to: 'iam@myfilmjobs.com',\n      subject: 'Test Email from My Film Jobs',\n      html: &#96;\n        \u003cdiv style=\"font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;\"\u003e\n          \u003ch2 style=\"color: #2563eb;\"\u003eTest Email\u003c/h2\u003e\n          \u003cp\u003eThis is a test email to verify the email notification system is working.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cp\u003eIf you receive this email, the SMTP configuration is correct!\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cp style=\"margin-top: 30px; font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280;\"\u003e\n            Best regards,\u003cbr\u003e\n            The My Film Jobs Team\n          \u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      &#96;,\n      text: &#96;Test Email\\n\\nThis is a test email to verify the email notification system is working.\\n\\nBest regards,\\nThe My Film Jobs Team&#96;\n    });\n\n    console.log('✅ Test email sent successfully!');\n    console.log('📧 Message ID:', info.messageId);\n    console.log('📬 Check your email inbox for the test message.\\n');",

Can you doble check that email notification is implemented and working? For example when someone receives a friend request, will they get an email. Also when recieving a message. I did an external check and got the following report. I had asumed this was implmented and working since out last conversation about it but by the report it seems, we're not. I had established a sendgrid account for this.

I've reviewed the email notification system in your application, and here's what I found:

Email Notification System:
The system uses an 
EmailNotificationService
 class that can send email notifications through a Firebase Cloud Function.
It includes rate limiting and user preference checks before sending emails.
Friend Request Notifications:
I couldn't find any implementation for friend request email notifications. The friend request functionality appears to be missing from the codebase.
Message Notifications:
When a user sends a message, the system creates a notification in the database via 
createMessageNotification
.
However, this only creates an in-app notification, not an email notification.
The code that would trigger an email notification is missing.
Current Implementation:
Notifications are stored in the 'notifications' collection in Firestore.
The system logs notifications but doesn't send email notifications for new messages.
Recommendations:
For Friend Requests:
You'll need to implement the friend request functionality first.
Add email notifications when a friend request is received.
For Message Notifications:
Add email notification logic in the 
createMessageNotification
 method.
Use the 
EmailNotificationService.sendNotification()
 method to send the email.
Testing:
The email notification system is configured to use a Firebase Cloud Function at https://us-central1-my-film-jobs.cloudfunctions.net/emailSend.
Ensure this function is properly set up and has the necessary email sending capabilities.

        "originalContents": "\n\n  static async sendNotification(data: EmailNotificationData): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[EmailNotificationService] Sending notification:', data);\n\n      // Check frequency limit using userId if available, otherwise use email\n      const userIdentifier = data.userId || data.to;\n      const canSend = await this.canSendEmail(userIdentifier, data.template || 'general');\n      if (!canSend) {\n        console.log(&#96;[EmailNotificationService] Frequency limit reached for ${data.to} (${data.template})&#96;);\n        return false;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(this.EMAIL_FUNCTION_URL, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          to: data.to,\n          subject: data.subject,\n          message: data.message,\n          senderName: data.senderName,\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const result = await response.json();\n      console.log('[EmailNotificationService] Response:', result);\n\n      if (result.success) {\n        // Update tracking after successful send\n        await this.updateEmailTracking(data.to, data.template || 'general');\n        return true;\n      }\n\n      return false;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending email notification:', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }",

EMAIL SENDING PROCESS\n================================================================================\n\nWhen an email needs to be sent:\n\na) EmailService.initialize() is called:\n   - Sets up Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP\n   - Configures SendGrid as fallback\n   - Loads email templates\n\nb) EmailService.sendEmail() is called with:\n   - Recipient email address\n   - Email template (subject, HTML, text)\n   - Template data (user names, project details, etc.)\n\nc) Email template is processed:\n   - Handlebars compiles the template\n   - Template data is injected\n   - HTML and text versions are generated\n\nd) Email is sent:\n   - Try SendGrid first (if configured)\n   - Fallback to Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP\n   - Log success/failure for monitoring\n\n5.       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Communications \u0026 Email Notification System\n\n## Overview\n\nThe My Film Jobs platform now includes a comprehensive communications and email notification system that handles both in-app notifications and email notifications. This system is designed to keep users informed about important events and activities across the platform.\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Components\n\n1. **Email Service** (&#96;functions/src/emailService.ts&#96;)\n   - Handles email sending via SendGrid and Nodemailer\n   - Provides email templates for different notification types\n   - Supports HTML and text email formats\n\n2. **Notification Service** (&#96;functions/src/notificationService.ts&#96;)\n   - Manages both in-app and email notifications\n   - Integrates with the Email Service\n   - Handles different notification types\n\n3. **User Preferences Service** (&#96;src/utilities/userPreferencesService.ts&#96;)\n   - Manages user notification preferences\n   - Controls email and push notification settings\n   - Provides granular control over notification types\n\n4. **Notification Settings UI** (&#96;src/components/NotificationSettings.tsx&#96;)\n   - User interface for managing notification preferences\n   - Real-time settings updates\n   - Intuitive toggle controls\n\n5. **Firebase Functions** (&#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;)\n   - Trigger-based notification system\n   - Real-time event handling\n   - Automatic email and in-app notification dispatch\n\n## Notification Types\n\n### 1. Job Application Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New job application submitted\n- **Recipients**: Job poster\n- **Content**: Applicant details, job title, company name\n- **Actions**: View application, respond to applicant\n\n### 2. Project Invitation Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New project invitation sent\n- **Recipients**: Invited user\n- **Content**: Project details, role, inviter information\n- **Actions**: Accept/decline invitation\n\n### 3. Task Assignment Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New task assigned to user\n- **Recipients**: Assigned user\n",

        "contents": "### Supported Notification Types\n- Job Application Notifications\n- Project Invitation Notifications\n- Task Assignment Notifications\n- Message Notifications\n- Project Update Notifications\n- Application Status Notifications\n\n## Firebase Functions\n\n### Function Triggers\n1. **&#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify job poster of new application\n\n2. **&#96;notifyProjectInvitation&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;projectInvitations/{invitationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify invitee of project invitation\n\n3. **&#96;notifyTaskAssignment&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;tasks/{taskId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify assignee of new task\n\n4. **&#96;notifyNewMessage&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify receiver of new message\n\n5. **&#96;notifyProjectUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;Projects/{projectId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify crew members of project changes\n\n6. **&#96;notifyApplicationStatusUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify applicant of status change\n\n## Email Service Configuration\n\n### Environment Variables\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# SendGrid Configuration\nSENDGRID_API_KEY=your_sendgrid_api_key\n\n# SMTP Configuration (fallback)\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=your_email@gmail.com\nSMTP_PASS=your_app_password\n\n# Email Configuration\nFROM_EMAIL=noreply@myfilmjobs.com\nFRONTEND_URL=https://myfilmjobs.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Email Providers\n1. **Primary**: SendGrid (recommended for production)\n2. **Fallback**: Nodemailer with SMTP (Gmail, etc.)\n\n## Implementation Guide\n\n### 1. Setup Email Service\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\ncd functions\nnpm install nodemailer @sendgrid/mail handlebars\n\n# Configure environment variables\n# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Deploy Firebase Functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Deploy functions\nfirebase deploy --only functions\n\n# Set environment variables\n",

            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169,
            "text": "### Email Providers"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170,
            "text": "1. **Primary**: SendGrid (recommended for production)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171,
            "text": "2. **Fallback**: Nodemailer with SMTP (Gmail, etc.)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173,
            "text": "## Implementation Guide"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175,
            "text": "### 1. Setup Email Service"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177,
            "text": "# Install dependencies"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "cd functions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179,
            "text": "npm install nodemailer @sendgrid/mail handlebars"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181,
            "text": "# Configure environment variables"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182,
            "text": "# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185,
            "text": "### 2. Deploy Firebase Functions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187,
            "text": "# Deploy functions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "firebase deploy --only functions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190,
            "text": "# Set environment variables"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191,
            "text": "firebase functions:config:set sendgrid.api_key=\"your_api_key\""
          }
        ],
        "originalContents": "### Supported Notification Types\n- Job Application Notifications\n- Project Invitation Notifications\n- Task Assignment Notifications\n- Message Notifications\n- Project Update Notifications\n- Application Status Notifications\n\n## Firebase Functions\n\n### Function Triggers\n1. **&#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify job poster of new application\n\n2. **&#96;notifyProjectInvitation&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;projectInvitations/{invitationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify invitee of project invitation\n\n3. **&#96;notifyTaskAssignment&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;tasks/{taskId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify assignee of new task\n\n4. **&#96;notifyNewMessage&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify receiver of new message\n\n5. **&#96;notifyProjectUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;Projects/{projectId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify crew members of project changes\n\n6. **&#96;notifyApplicationStatusUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify applicant of status change\n\n## Email Service Configuration\n\n### Environment Variables\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# SendGrid Configuration\nSENDGRID_API_KEY=your_sendgrid_api_key\n\n# SMTP Configuration (fallback)\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=your_email@gmail.com\nSMTP_PASS=your_app_password\n\n# Email Configuration\nFROM_EMAIL=noreply@myfilmjobs.com\nFRONTEND_URL=https://myfilmjobs.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Email Providers\n1. **Primary**: SendGrid (recommended for production)\n2. **Fallback**: Nodemailer with SMTP (Gmail, etc.)\n\n## Implementation Guide\n\n### 1. Setup Email Service\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\ncd functions\nnpm install nodemailer @sendgrid/mail handlebars\n\n# Configure environment variables\n# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Deploy Firebase Functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Deploy functions\nfirebase deploy --only functions\n\n# Set environment variables\n",

max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;\"\u003e\n          \u003ch2 style=\"color: #2563eb;\"\u003eMy Film Jobs\u003c/h2\u003e\n          \u003cp\u003eHello,\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cp\u003eYou have received a new message from \u003cstrong\u003e${senderName || 'My Film Jobs'}\u003c/strong\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cdiv style=\"background-color: #f3f4f6;         "originalContents": "\n\n// Main email sending function - Production ready\nexport const emailSend = onRequest({\n  cors: true,\n  invoker: 'public',\n  region: 'us-central1'\n}, async (req, res) =\u003e {\n  // Handle CORS preflight\n  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {\n    res.status(204).send('');\n    return;\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const { to, subject, message, senderName } = req.body;\n    \n    if (!to || !subject || !message) {\n      res.status(400).json({ \n        error: 'Missing required fields: to, subject, message' \n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Create email template\n    const emailTemplate = {\n      subject: subject || &#96;New message from ${senderName || 'My Film Jobs'}&#96;,\n      html: &#96;\n        \u003cdiv style=\"font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;\"\u003e\n          \u003ch2 style=\"color: #2563eb;\"\u003eMy Film Jobs\u003c/h2\u003e\n          \u003cp\u003eHello,\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cp\u003eYou have received a new message from \u003cstrong\u003e${senderName || 'My Film Jobs'}\u003c/strong\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003cdiv style=\"background-color: #f3f4f6; font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280;\"\u003e\n            Best regards,\u003cbr\u003e\n            The My Film Jobs Team\n          \u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      &#96;,\n      text: &#96;\nMy Film Jobs\n\nHello,\n\nYou have received a new message from ${senderName || 'My Film Jobs'}.\n\nMessage:\n${message}\n\nBest regards,\nThe My Film Jobs Team\n      &#96;\n    };\n\n    // Send the email using EmailService\n    const success = await EmailService.sendEmail({\n      to,\n      template: emailTemplate,\n      data: {\n        senderName: senderName || 'My Film Jobs',\n        message\n      }\n    });",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Email Notification System Implementation Summary\n\n## 🎯 **Problem Solved**\n\n### **Original Issues:**\n1. ❌ User not receiving email notifications\n2. ❌ Too many chat notifications (one per message)\n3. ❌ No consolidated notification system\n\n### **Solutions Implemented:**\n1. ✅ **Comprehensive Email System** - Full email notification infrastructure\n2. ✅ **Daily Digest Feature** - Consolidated daily notifications\n3. ✅ **Smart Notification Logic** - Configurable notification preferences\n4. ✅ **Testing Framework** - Easy testing and debugging tools\n\n## 📧 **Daily Digest Feature**\n\n### **🎯 What It Does:**\n- **Consolidates notifications** into one daily email\n- **Reduces email spam** from multiple messages\n- **User-configurable** preferences and timing\n- **Smart logic** - immediate for important notifications, daily for messages\n\n### **🔧 How It Works:**\n\n#### **1. User Preferences**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface UserPreferences {\n  // ... existing fields\n  dailyDigestEnabled: boolean;           // Enable/disable daily digest\n  messageNotificationFrequency: 'immediate' | 'daily' | 'weekly';\n  digestTime: string;                    // e.g., \"09:00\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **2. Daily Digest Service**\n- **Collects** all unread notifications from last 24 hours\n- **Groups** by type (messages, job applications, etc.)\n- **Sends** consolidated email with summary\n- **Respects** user preferences and timing\n\n#### **3. Smart Notification Logic**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// For messages: Check user preference\nif (userPreferences.messageNotificationFrequency === 'daily') {\n  // Store for daily digest instead of sending immediately\n  await this.storeForDailyDigest(userId, notification);\n} else {\n  // Send immediate notification\n  await this.sendImmediateNotification(userId, notification);\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### **📋 User Options:**\n- ✅ **Enable/disable** daily digest\n- ✅ **Choose digest time** (e.g., 09:00 AM)\n- ✅ **Set message frequency** (immediate, daily, weekly)\n",

        "contents": "================================================================================\n                     EMAIL NOTIFICATION SYSTEM - HOW IT WORKS\n================================================================================\n\nThis document explains how the My Film Jobs email notification system works, from \nuser interaction to email delivery.\n\n================================================================================\n                            SYSTEM OVERVIEW\n================================================================================\n\nThe email notification system is a comprehensive solution that handles both \nin-app notifications and email delivery. Application Status Update Notifications\n- **Trigger**: Job application status changed\n- **Recipients**: Applicant\n- **Content**: Status change, job details\n- **Actions**: View application details\n\n## Email Templates\n\n### Template Features\n- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-friendly email layouts\n- **Brand Consistency**: My Film Jobs branding and colors\n- **Action Buttons**: Direct links to relevant pages\n- **Personalization**: User-specific content and data\n- **Fallback Support**: Text versions for email clients\n\n### Template Types\n1. **Job Application Template**\n   - Professional layout with application details\n   - Direct link to application review\n\n2. **Project Invitation Template**\n   - Clear project information\n   - Accept/decline action buttons\n\n3. **Task Assignment Template**\n   - Task details with due date\n   - Direct link to task management\n\n4. **Message Notification Template**\n   - Sender information and message preview\n   - Link to conversation\n\n5. **Project Update Template**\n   - Change summary and updater information\n   - Link to updated project\n\n6. **Application Status Template**\n   - Status change notification\n   - Professional formatting\n\n## User Preferences\n\n### Notification Settings\n- **Email Notifications**: Enable/disable email notifications\n- **Push Notifications**: Enable/disable browser push notifications\n- **Notification Frequency**: Immediate, daily digest, or weekly digest\n- **Granular Control**: Toggle specific notification types\n\n",

Application Status Update Notifications\n- **Trigger**: Job application status changed\n- **Recipients**: Applicant\n- **Content**: Status change, job details\n- **Actions**: View application details\n\n## Email Templates\n\n### Template Features\n- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-friendly email layouts\n- **Brand Consistency**: My Film Jobs branding and colors\n- **Action Buttons**: Direct links to relevant pages\n- **Personalization**: User-specific content and data\n- **Fallback Support**: Text versions for email clients\n\n### Template Types\n1. **Job Application Template**\n   - Professional layout with application details\n   - Direct link to application review\n\n2. **Project Invitation Template**\n   - Clear project information\n   - Accept/decline action buttons\n\n3. **Task Assignment Template**\n   - Task details with due date\n   - Direct link to task management\n\n4. **Message Notification Template**\n   - Sender information and message preview\n   - Link to conversation\n\n5. **Project Update Template**\n   - Change summary and updater information\n   - Link to updated project\n\n6. **Application Status Template**\n   - Status change notification\n   - Professional formatting\n\n## User Preferences\n\n### Notification Settings\n- **Email Notifications**: Enable/disable email notifications\n- **Push Notifications**: Enable/disable browser push notifications\n- **Notification Frequency**: Immediate, daily digest, or weekly digest\n- **Granular Control**: Toggle specific notification types\n\n",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Send a follow request to another user\n   */\n  static async sendFollowRequest(followerId: string, followingId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check if follow relationship already exists\n      const existingFollow = await this.getFollow(followerId, followingId);\n      if (existingFollow) {\n        if (existingFollow.status === 'pending') {\n          throw new Error('Follow request already sent');\n        } else if (existingFollow.status === 'accepted') {\n          throw new Error('Already following this user');\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Create new follow request\n      const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n      await setDoc(followRef, {\n        followerId,\n        followingId,\n        status: 'pending',\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n      });\n\n      // Create notification for the user being followed\n      await this.createNotification({\n        userId: followingId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        message: 'sent you a follow request',\n        metadata: { followerId }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\nclass EmailNotificationService {\n  private static readonly EMAIL_FUNCTION_URL = 'https://us-central1-my-film-jobs.cloudfunctions.net/emailSend';\n  private static readonly WEEKLY_LIMIT_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 7 days in milliseconds\n\n  // Check if user can receive email based on preferences and frequency\n  private static async canSendEmail(userIdentifier: string, template: string): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n    try {\n      // First check if user has email notifications enabled\n      // Try to get user by ID first, then by email\n      let userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userIdentifier));\n      \n      if (!userDoc.exists()) {\n        // Try to find user by email\n        const usersRef = collection(db, 'users');\n        const q = query(usersRef, where('email', '==', userIdentifier));\n        const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);\n        \n        if (!querySnapshot.empty) {\n          userDoc = querySnapshot.docs[0];\n        }\n      }",

        "originalContents": "\n\nclass EmailNotificationService {\n  private static readonly EMAIL_FUNCTION_URL = 'https://us-central1-my-film-jobs.cloudfunctions.net/emailSend';\n  private static readonly WEEKLY_LIMIT_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 7 days in milliseconds\n\n  // Check if user can receive email based on preferences and frequency\n  private static async canSendEmail(userIdentifier: string, template: string): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n    try {\n      // First check if user has email notifications enabled\n      // Try to get user by ID first, then by email\n      let userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userIdentifier));\n      \n      if (!userDoc.exists()) {\n        // Try to find user by email\n        const usersRef = collection(db, 'users');\n        const q = query(usersRef, where('email', '==', userIdentifier));\n        const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);\n        \n        if (!querySnapshot.empty) {\n          userDoc = querySnapshot.docs[0];\n        }\n      }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "================================================================================\n\nWhen a user opens the notification settings:\n\na) The NotificationSettings component loads user preferences from Firestore\nb) User can toggle different notification types:\n   - Email Notifications (on/off)\n   - Push Notifications (on/off)\n   - Job Application Notifications\n   - Project Invitation Notifications\n   - Task Assignment Notifications\n   - Message Notifications\n   - Project Update Notifications\n   - Application Status Notifications\n\nc) User can set notification frequency:\n   - Immediate: Send notifications right away\n   - Daily: Send digest once per day\n   - Weekly: Send digest once per week\n\nd) Changes are saved to Firestore in real-time\n\n2. EVENT TRIGGERS\n================================================================================\n\nThe system monitors various events in your app:\n\na) Job Application Submitted:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"jobApplications/{applicationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify job poster about new application\n   - Email Template: Professional application notification\n\nb) Project Invitation Sent:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"projectInvitations/{invitationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify invited user about project invitation\n   - Email Template: Project invitation with role details\n\nc) Task Assigned:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"tasks/{taskId}\")\n   - Action: Notify assignee about new task\n   - Email Template: Task assignment with due date\n\nd) New Message:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}\")\n   - Action: Notify recipient about new message\n   - Email Template: Message preview with sender info\n\ne) Project Updated:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentUpdated(\"Projects/{projectId}\")\n   - Action: Notify team members about project changes\n   - Email Template: Project update summary\n\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "1. USER PREFERENCE MANAGEMENT"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "================================================================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "When a user opens the notification settings:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "a) The NotificationSettings component loads user preferences from Firestore"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "b) User can toggle different notification types:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "   - Email Notifications (on/off)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "   - Push Notifications (on/off)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "   - Job Application Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "   - Project Invitation Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "   - Task Assignment Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51,
            "text": "   - Message Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "   - Project Update Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "   - Application Status Notifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "c) User can set notification frequency:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "   - Immediate: Send notifications right away"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "   - Daily: Send digest once per day"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "   - Weekly: Send digest once per week"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "d) Changes are saved to Firestore in real-time"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "2. EVENT TRIGGERS"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "================================================================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "The system monitors various events in your app:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "a) Job Application Submitted:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"jobApplications/{applicationId}\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69,
            "text": "   - Action: Notify job poster about new application"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "   - Email Template: Professional application notification"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "b) Project Invitation Sent:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73,
            "text": "   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"projectInvitations/{invitationId}\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "   - Action: Notify invited user about project invitation"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "   - Email Template: Project invitation with role details"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "c) Task Assigned:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78,
            "text": "   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"tasks/{taskId}\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "   - Action: Notify assignee about new task"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "   - Email Template: Task assignment with due date"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "d) New Message:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": "   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84,
            "text": "   - Action: Notify recipient about new message"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "   - Email Template: Message preview with sender info"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87,
            "text": "e) Project Updated:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "   - Trigger: onDocumentUpdated(\"Projects/{projectId}\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "   - Action: Notify team members about project changes"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "   - Email Template: Project update summary"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "f) Application Status Changed:"
          },
          {

EVENT TRIGGERS\n================================================================================\n\nThe system monitors various events in your app:\n\na) Job Application Submitted:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"jobApplications/{applicationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify job poster about new application\n   - Email Template: Professional application notification\n\nb) Project Invitation Sent:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"projectInvitations/{invitationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify invited user about project invitation\n   - Email Template: Project invitation with role details\n\nc) Task Assigned:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"tasks/{taskId}\")\n   - Action: Notify assignee about new task\n   - Email Template: Task assignment with due date\n\nd) New Message:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}\")\n   - Action: Notify recipient about new message\n   - Email Template: Message preview with sender info\n\ne) Project Updated:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentUpdated(\"Projects/{projectId}\")\n   - Action: Notify team members about project changes\n   - Email Template: Project update summary\n\n",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // ===== NOTIFICATION MANAGEMENT =====\n  \n  static async createMessageNotification(\n    receiverId: string, \n    senderId: string, \n    messageId: string, \n    content: string, \n    messageType: string\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[MessagingService] Creating message notification for:', receiverId);\n      \n      // Get sender info\n      const senderProfile = await this.getUserProfile(senderId);\n      const senderName = senderProfile?.displayName || 'Unknown User';\n      \n      // Create notification with message preview\n      const messagePreview = content.length \u003e 50 ? content.substring(0, 50) + '...' : content;\n      await addDoc(collection(db, 'notifications'), {\n        userId: receiverId,\n        type: \"message\",\n        message: &#96;New message from ${senderName}: ${messagePreview}&#96;,\n        senderId: senderId,\n        messageId: messageId,\n        read: false,\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n      \n      console.log('[MessagingService] Message notification created successfully');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[MessagingService] Error creating message notification:', error);\n      // Don't throw error - notification failure shouldn't break message sending\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "class EmailNotificationService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static async sendNotification(data: EmailNotificationData): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[EmailNotificationService] Sending notification:', data);\n\n      // Check frequency limit using userId if available, otherwise use email\n      const userIdentifier = data.userId || data.to;\n      const canSend = await this.canSendEmail(userIdentifier, data.template || 'general');\n      if (!canSend) {\n        console.log(&#96;[EmailNotificationService] Frequency limit reached for ${data.to} (${data.template})&#96;);\n        return false;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(this.EMAIL_FUNCTION_URL, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          to: data.to,\n          subject: data.subject,\n          message: data.message,\n          senderName: data.senderName,\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const result = await response.json();\n      console.log('[EmailNotificationService] Response:', result);\n\n      if (result.success) {\n        // Update tracking after successful send\n        await this.updateEmailTracking(data.to, data.template || 'general');\n        return true;\n      }\n\n      return false;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending email notification:', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  static async sendNotification(data: EmailNotificationData): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[EmailNotificationService] Sending notification:', data);\n\n      // Check frequency limit using userId if available, otherwise use email\n      const userIdentifier = data.userId || data.to;\n      const canSend = await this.canSendEmail(userIdentifier, data.template || 'general');\n      if (!canSend) {\n        console.log(&#96;[EmailNotificationService] Frequency limit reached for ${data.to} (${data.template})&#96;);\n        return false;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(this.EMAIL_FUNCTION_URL, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          to: data.to,\n          subject: data.subject,\n          message: data.message,\n          senderName: data.senderName,\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const result = await response.json();\n      console.log('[EmailNotificationService] Response:', result);\n\n      if (result.success) {\n        // Update tracking after successful send\n        await this.updateEmailTracking(data.to, data.template || 'general');\n        return true;\n      }\n\n      return false;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending email notification:', error);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "# Email Notification System Implementation Summary\n\n## 🎯 **Problem Solved**\n\n### **Original Issues:**\n1. ❌ User not receiving email notifications\n2. ❌ Too many chat notifications (one per message)\n3. ❌ No consolidated notification system\n\n### **Solutions Implemented:**\n1. ✅ **Comprehensive Email System** - Full email notification infrastructure\n2. ✅ **Daily Digest Feature** - Consolidated daily notifications\n3. ✅ **Smart Notification Logic** - Configurable notification preferences\n4. ✅ **Testing Framework** - Easy testing and debugging tools\n\n## 📧 **Daily Digest Feature**\n\n### **🎯 What It Does:**\n- **Consolidates notifications** into one daily email\n- **Reduces email spam** from multiple messages\n- **User-configurable** preferences and timing\n- **Smart logic** - immediate for important notifications, daily for messages\n\n### **🔧 How It Works:**\n\n#### **1. User Preferences**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface UserPreferences {\n  // ... existing fields\n  dailyDigestEnabled: boolean;           // Enable/disable daily digest\n  messageNotificationFrequency: 'immediate' | 'daily' | 'weekly';\n  digestTime: string;                    // e.g., \"09:00\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **2. Daily Digest Service**\n- **Collects** all unread notifications from last 24 hours\n- **Groups** by type (messages, job applications, etc.)\n- **Sends** consolidated email with summary\n- **Respects** user preferences and timing\n\n#### **3. Smart Notification Logic**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// For messages: Check user preference\nif (userPreferences.messageNotificationFrequency === 'daily') {\n  // Store for daily digest instead of sending immediately\n  await this.storeForDailyDigest(userId, notification);\n} else {\n  // Send immediate notification\n  await this.sendImmediateNotification(userId, notification);\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### **📋 User Options:**\n- ✅ **Enable/disable** daily digest\n- ✅ **Choose digest time** (e.g., 09:00 AM)\n- ✅ **Set message frequency** (immediate, daily, weekly)\n",

        "contents": "f) Application Status Changed:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentUpdated(\"jobApplications/{applicationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify applicant about status change\n   - Email Template: Status update with next steps\n\n3. NOTIFICATION CREATION PROCESS\n================================================================================\n\nWhen an event is triggered:\n\na) Firebase Function detects the event\nb) Function calls NotificationService.createNotification()\nc) NotificationService:\n   - Creates in-app notification in Firestore\n   - Checks user preferences for email notifications\n   - If email is enabled, calls EmailService.sendEmail()\n   - Uses Handlebars templates to generate email content\n\n4. EMAIL SENDING PROCESS\n================================================================================\n\nWhen an email needs to be sent:\n\na) EmailService.initialize() is called:\n   - Sets up Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP\n   - Configures SendGrid as fallback\n   - Loads email templates\n\nb) EmailService.sendEmail() is called with:\n   - Recipient email address\n   - Email template (subject, HTML, text)\n   - Template data (user names, project details, etc.)\n\nc) Email template is processed:\n   - Handlebars compiles the template\n   - Template data is injected\n   - HTML and text versions are generated\n\nd) Email is sent:\n   - Try SendGrid first (if configured)\n   - Fallback to Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP\n   - Log success/failure for monitoring\n\n5. EMAIL TEMPLATES\n================================================================================\n\nEach notification type has its own email template:\n\na) Template Structure:\n   - Subject line with dynamic data\n   - HTML version (styled, professional)\n   - Text version (plain text fallback)\n   - Handlebars variables for personalization\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "================================================================================\n\nWhen a user opens the notification settings:\n\na) The NotificationSettings component loads user preferences from Firestore\nb) User can toggle different notification types:\n   - Email Notifications (on/off)\n   - Push Notifications (on/off)\n   - Job Application Notifications\n   - Project Invitation Notifications\n   - Task Assignment Notifications\n   - Message Notifications\n   - Project Update Notifications\n   - Application Status Notifications\n\nc) User can set notification frequency:\n   - Immediate: Send notifications right away\n   - Daily: Send digest once per day\n   - Weekly: Send digest once per week\n\nd) Changes are saved to Firestore in real-time\n\n2. EVENT TRIGGERS\n================================================================================\n\nThe system monitors various events in your app:\n\na) Job Application Submitted:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"jobApplications/{applicationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify job poster about new application\n   - Email Template: Professional application notification\n\nb) Project Invitation Sent:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"projectInvitations/{invitationId}\")\n   - Action: Notify invited user about project invitation\n   - Email Template: Project invitation with role details\n\nc) Task Assigned:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"tasks/{taskId}\")\n   - Action: Notify assignee about new task\n   - Email Template: Task assignment with due date\n\nd) New Message:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentCreated(\"conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}\")\n   - Action: Notify recipient about new message\n   - Email Template: Message preview with sender info\n\ne) Project Updated:\n   - Trigger: onDocumentUpdated(\"Projects/{projectId}\")\n   - Action: Notify team members about project changes\n   - Email Template: Project update summary\n\n",
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Communications \u0026 Email Notification System\n\n## Overview\n\nThe My Film Jobs platform now includes a comprehensive communications and email notification system that handles both in-app notifications and email notifications. This system is designed to keep users informed about important events and activities across the platform.\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Components\n\n1. **Email Service** (&#96;functions/src/emailService.ts&#96;)\n   - Handles email sending via SendGrid and Nodemailer\n   - Provides email templates for different notification types\n   - Supports HTML and text email formats\n\n2. **Notification Service** (&#96;functions/src/notificationService.ts&#96;)\n   - Manages both in-app and email notifications\n   - Integrates with the Email Service\n   - Handles different notification types\n\n3. **User Preferences Service** (&#96;src/utilities/userPreferencesService.ts&#96;)\n   - Manages user notification preferences\n   - Controls email and push notification settings\n   - Provides granular control over notification types\n\n4. **Notification Settings UI** (&#96;src/components/NotificationSettings.tsx&#96;)\n   - User interface for managing notification preferences\n   - Real-time settings updates\n   - Intuitive toggle controls\n\n5. **Firebase Functions** (&#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;)\n   - Trigger-based notification system\n   - Real-time event handling\n   - Automatic email and in-app notification dispatch\n\n## Notification Types\n\n### 1. Job Application Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New job application submitted\n- **Recipients**: Job poster\n- **Content**: Applicant details, job title, company name\n- **Actions**: View application, respond to applicant\n\n### 2. Project Invitation Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New project invitation sent\n- **Recipients**: Invited user\n- **Content**: Project details, role, inviter information\n- **Actions**: Accept/decline invitation\n\n### 3. Task Assignment Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New task assigned to user\n- **Recipients**: Assigned user\n",

        "originalContents": "# Communications \u0026 Email Notification System\n\n## Overview\n\nThe My Film Jobs platform now includes a comprehensive communications and email notification system that handles both in-app notifications and email notifications. This system is designed to keep users informed about important events and activities across the platform.\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Components\n\n1. **Email Service** (&#96;functions/src/emailService.ts&#96;)\n   - Handles email sending via SendGrid and Nodemailer\n   - Provides email templates for different notification types\n   - Supports HTML and text email formats\n\n2. **Notification Service** (&#96;functions/src/notificationService.ts&#96;)\n   - Manages both in-app and email notifications\n   - Integrates with the Email Service\n   - Handles different notification types\n\n3. **User Preferences Service** (&#96;src/utilities/userPreferencesService.ts&#96;)\n   - Manages user notification preferences\n   - Controls email and push notification settings\n   - Provides granular control over notification types\n\n4. **Notification Settings UI** (&#96;src/components/NotificationSettings.tsx&#96;)\n   - User interface for managing notification preferences\n   - Real-time settings updates\n   - Intuitive toggle controls\n\n5. **Firebase Functions** (&#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;)\n   - Trigger-based notification system\n   - Real-time event handling\n   - Automatic email and in-app notification dispatch\n\n## Notification Types\n\n### 1. Job Application Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New job application submitted\n- **Recipients**: Job poster\n- **Content**: Applicant details, job title, company name\n- **Actions**: View application, respond to applicant\n\n### 2. Project Invitation Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New project invitation sent\n- **Recipients**: Invited user\n- **Content**: Project details, role, inviter information\n- **Actions**: Accept/decline invitation\n\n### 3. Task Assignment Notifications\n- **Trigger**: New task assigned to user\n- **Recipients**: Assigned user\n",

Perfect! Now I can see the issue. The email function is failing because it's not getting the SMTP credentials properly. The logs show:

```
[EmailService] SMTP Config: { host: 'smtp.gmail.com', port: 587, user: '' }
```

The user field is empty, which means the Firebase function configuration isn't being read correctly. Let me check how the EmailService is reading the configuration:

        "originalContents": "# Firebase Configuration Template\n# Copy this file to .env and replace the placeholder values with your actual Firebase project credentials\n# You can find these values in your Firebase Console under Project Settings \u003e General \u003e Your apps\n\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_api_key_here\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=whosonsetdepez.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=whosonsetdepez\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=whosonsetdepez.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_messaging_sender_id_here\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_app_id_here\n\n# Optional: Development settings\nNODE_ENV=development\nREACT_APP_ENVIRONMENT=development\n\n# Optional: Feature flags\nREACT_APP_ENABLE_ANALYTICS=true\nREACT_APP_ENABLE_MESSAGING=true\nREACT_APP_ENABLE_SOCIAL_FEATURES=true ",

        "contents": "### Supported Notification Types\n- Job Application Notifications\n- Project Invitation Notifications\n- Task Assignment Notifications\n- Message Notifications\n- Project Update Notifications\n- Application Status Notifications\n\n## Firebase Functions\n\n### Function Triggers\n1. **&#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify job poster of new application\n\n2. **&#96;notifyProjectInvitation&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;projectInvitations/{invitationId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify invitee of project invitation\n\n3. **&#96;notifyTaskAssignment&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;tasks/{taskId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify assignee of new task\n\n4. **&#96;notifyNewMessage&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}&#96; document created\n   - Action: Notify receiver of new message\n\n5. **&#96;notifyProjectUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;Projects/{projectId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify crew members of project changes\n\n6. **&#96;notifyApplicationStatusUpdate&#96;**\n   - Trigger: &#96;jobApplications/{applicationId}&#96; document updated\n   - Action: Notify applicant of status change\n\n## Email Service Configuration\n\n### Environment Variables\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\n# SendGrid Configuration\nSENDGRID_API_KEY=your_sendgrid_api_key\n\n# SMTP Configuration (fallback)\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=your_email@gmail.com\nSMTP_PASS=your_app_password\n\n# Email Configuration\nFROM_EMAIL=noreply@myfilmjobs.com\nFRONTEND_URL=https://myfilmjobs.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Email Providers\n1. **Primary**: SendGrid (recommended for production)\n2. **Fallback**: Nodemailer with SMTP (Gmail, etc.)\n\n## Implementation Guide\n\n### 1. Setup Email Service\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\ncd functions\nnpm install nodemailer @sendgrid/mail handlebars\n\n# Configure environment variables\n# Add to .env or Firebase Functions environment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Deploy Firebase Functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Deploy functions\nfirebase deploy --only functions\n\n# Set environment variables\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\nimport { getStorage } from \"firebase/storage\";\n\nconst firebaseConfig = {\n  apiKey:     process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY,\n  authDomain: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,\n  projectId:  process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n  storageBucket: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,\n  messagingSenderId: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,\n  appId:      process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID,\n};\n\nconst app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);\nconst auth = getAuth(app);\n\n// Initialize Firestore with settings to prevent internal assertion errors\nconst db = initializeFirestore(app, {\n  cacheSizeBytes: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB cache\n  experimentalForceLongPolling: true, // Use long polling instead of WebSocket\n});\n\nconst storage = getStorage(app);\n\n// Error handling for Firestore\nconst handleFirestoreError = (error: any) =\u003e {\n  console.error('Firestore error:', error);\n  // Attempt to reconnect if there's a connection issue\n  if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n    console.log('Attempting to reconnect to Firestore...');\n    enableNetwork(db).catch(console.error);\n  }\n};",

        "originalContents": "\nimport { getStorage } from \"firebase/storage\";\n\nconst firebaseConfig = {\n  apiKey:     process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY,\n  authDomain: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,\n  projectId:  process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n  storageBucket: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,\n  messagingSenderId: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,\n  appId:      process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID,\n};\n\nconst app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);\nconst auth = getAuth(app);\n\n// Initialize Firestore with settings to prevent internal assertion errors\nconst db = initializeFirestore(app, {\n  cacheSizeBytes: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB cache\n  experimentalForceLongPolling: true, // Use long polling instead of WebSocket\n});\n\nconst storage = getStorage(app);\n\n// Error handling for Firestore\nconst handleFirestoreError = (error: any) =\u003e {\n  console.error('Firestore error:', error);\n  // Attempt to reconnect if there's a connection issue\n  if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n    console.log('Attempting to reconnect to Firestore...');\n    enableNetwork(db).catch(console.error);\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "firebase deploy --only storage --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Storage Folders:**\n- [ ] &#96;project-images/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;profileImages/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;screenplays/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;chat-uploads/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-images/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-audio/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;users/{userId}/&#96; - User-specific access\n\n### 6. ⚡ Cloud Functions\nDeploy the functions from &#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only functions --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Current Functions:**\n- [ ] &#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96; - Notifies job poster on new application\n\n### 7. 🌐 Hosting Configuration\nDeploy the hosting configuration:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only hosting --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Hosting Settings:**\n- [ ] Public directory: &#96;public&#96;\n- [ ] SPA fallback: &#96;index.html&#96;\n- [ ] Ignore patterns configured\n\n### 8. 📝 Reference Data Seeding\n\n#### Job Titles (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-titles\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Job Departments (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-departments\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Countries (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:countries\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 9. 🔧 Environment Configuration\n\n#### Create &#96;.env.production&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_prod_project.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_prod_project_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_prod_project.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_sender_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Update &#96;package.json&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"deploy:prod\": \"firebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 10. 🚀 Complete Deployment Commands\n\n#### First-Time Setup:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Initialize Firebase for production\nfirebase use --add\n# Select your production project\n\n# 2. Deploy everything\nfirebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\n\n# 3.         "originalContents": "firebase deploy --only storage --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Storage Folders:**\n- [ ] &#96;project-images/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;profileImages/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;screenplays/&#96; - Public read, auth write\n- [ ] &#96;chat-uploads/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-images/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;chat-audio/&#96; - Auth only\n- [ ] &#96;users/{userId}/&#96; - User-specific access\n\n### 6. ⚡ Cloud Functions\nDeploy the functions from &#96;functions/src/index.ts&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only functions --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Current Functions:**\n- [ ] &#96;notifyJobPosterOnApplication&#96; - Notifies job poster on new application\n\n### 7. 🌐 Hosting Configuration\nDeploy the hosting configuration:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase deploy --only hosting --project your-prod-project-id\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Hosting Settings:**\n- [ ] Public directory: &#96;public&#96;\n- [ ] SPA fallback: &#96;index.html&#96;\n- [ ] Ignore patterns configured\n\n### 8. 📝 Reference Data Seeding\n\n#### Job Titles (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-titles\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Job Departments (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:job-departments\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Countries (if needed):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run seed:countries\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 9. 🔧 Environment Configuration\n\n#### Create &#96;.env.production&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your_prod_api_key\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=your_prod_project.firebaseapp.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your_prod_project_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=your_prod_project.appspot.com\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=your_prod_sender_id\nREACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID=your_prod_app_id\nREACT_APP_ENV=production\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Update &#96;package.json&#96;:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"deploy:prod\": \"firebase deploy --project your-prod-project-id\"\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 10. 🚀 Complete Deployment Commands\n\n#### First-Time Setup:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. USER INTERFACE COMPONENTS\n================================================================================\n\nNotificationSettings Component:\n- Modern, intuitive interface\n- Real-time feedback with loading states\n- Granular control for each notification type\n- Frequency options (immediate/daily/weekly)\n- Error handling with retry options\n\nNotificationCenter Component:\n- Search and filter functionality\n- Bulk selection and actions\n- Visual type indicators with emoji icons\n- Smart sorting with unread prioritization\n- Real-time updates and status tracking\n\n7. CONFIGURATION AND SETUP\n================================================================================\n\nEmail Configuration:\n- Gmail SMTP: smtp.gmail.com:587\n- Google Workspace account: iam@myfilmjobs.com\n- App password authentication\n- Firebase Functions config storage\n\nFirebase Functions Config:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.host=\"smtp.gmail.com\"\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.port=\"587\"\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.user=\"iam@myfilmjobs.com\"\nfirebase functions:config:set smtp.pass=\"[app-password]\"\nfirebase functions:config:set email.from=\"iam@myfilmjobs.com\"\nfirebase functions:config:set app.frontend_url=\"https://myfilmjobs.com\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n8.
